_help: Skill manifest (source of truth). Copy to skills/<skill-name>/manifest.json and fill in. The 'name' MUST match the folder name. Only register commands that actually exist. 'intents' maps an intent id to trigger phrases; matching is deterministic (every token of a phrase must appear in the request).
name: my-skill
description: One or two sentences: what this skill does and when to use it. Longer descriptions help the description-matching signal.
